Q: Portably disabling FMA for a single function A:

Have you tested (float) (a*b) - (float) (c*d)? Per the C and C++ standards, casts are supposed to discard “excess precision,” meaning that this expression cannot be contracted with an FMA. If that does not work, test float t0 = a*b, t1 = c*d; … t0 - t1; assignments are also supposed to discard “excess precision,” and that might be respected more than a cast.

Q: Docker official registry (Docker Hub) URL A:

For those trying to create a Google Cloud instance using the "Deploy a container image to this VM instance." option then the correct url format would be

docker.io/<dockerimagename>:version

The suggestion of registry.hub.docker.com/library/<dockerimagename> did not work for me.

I finally found the solution here (in my case, I was trying to run docker.io/tensorflow/serving:latest)

EDIT: Try to use: registry-1.docker.io (notice its not the same as registry.hub.docker.com)

Q: Jupyter in vscode - convert to raw NBCovert or deactivate cell? A:

JupyterSync VS Code extension provides what you're looking for.

The following keybindings are available when a notebook editor is focused and you are not currently typing in a cell input or output area:
    y: Jupytext: Change Cell to default Code
    r: Jupytext: Toggle Cell between Raw Code and default Code
    t: Jupytext: Insert Raw Code Cell Below and Focus Container
    e: Jupytext: Insert Raw Code Cell Above and Focus Container
    i i (press i twice): jupyter.interruptkernel (VS Code built-in)
    0 0 (press 0 twice): jupyter.restartkernel (VS Code built-in)

Extension GitHub link

And don't forget to install Jupytext - it won't work without it. Example:

C:\ProgramData\anaconda3\python.exe -m pip install jupytext

Q: Do you feel that AI tools are replacing the need for Stack Overflow? A:

I have seen many AI responses being based on SO articles. In one extreme case I was presented with an answer based on my own SO question. AI did not even detect that what I had posted were my investigations so far which I had proven to not work.

If AI needs SO so badly there is no way it can replace it.
